title: Deployment Risk Matrix — Owner Self-Use (PASS 46)

risks.risk: Env contract drifts (a var silently moves required<->optional, or a phantom var re-added as required) so deploys fail unexpectedly or block on a var nothing reads.
risks.mitigation: REQUIRED_ENV_VARS.json is the canonical manifest; owner-self-use-env-contract-consistency.test.ts fails CI on drift across manifest/.env.example/preflight/validate-deployment.

risks.risk: NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL set only at runtime, not at build; absolute links/redirects point at the wrong origin.
risks.mitigation: Schema + runbook + prechecklist state it is inlined at build and must be set before `npm run build`.

risks.risk: Destructive or partial migration against the owner's real DB.
risks.mitigation: Explicit separate step; manual-only production gate (workflow_dispatch, PRODUCTION_DATABASE_URL, migrate deploy only, never reset/seed — enforced by bootable-production-env-contract.test.ts); prechecklist requires backup + migrate status first; rollback prefers restore-from-backup.

risks.risk: Secret value committed, logged, or returned in a response.
risks.mitigation: Preflight prints [SET]/[NOT SET] only; manifest/docs carry names not values (asserted by the consistency test's secret-scan); smoke S9 checks responses/bundles; validate-deployment security checks (.env not in git).

risks.risk: A CI/test-only var (TEST_WITH_DB, SKIP_ENV_VALIDATION, RUN_LIVE_AI, LOGIN_RATE_LIMIT_MAX_ATTEMPTS) leaks into production and weakens behavior.
risks.mitigation: Classified explicitly as CI_TEST_ONLY with mustNotBeProd; prechecklist §A requires all unset; consistency test asserts none are declared production-required; LOGIN_RATE_LIMIT_MAX_ATTEMPTS is clamped >= prod default so it cannot weaken prod even if present.

risks.risk: Internal diagnostic/ops endpoints exposed without a key.
risks.mitigation: OPSIQ_DIAGNOSTIC_KEY gates them fail-closed when unset; smoke S11 verifies; documented as optional (leave unset for self-use).

risks.risk: PII entered via manual-entry reaches storage.
risks.mitigation: Client + server PII guard (PASS 45) reusing the proven stripPii; smoke S6 is a hard stop condition; browser spec 51 covers it live.

risks.risk: The real boot path (instrumentation -> startup-orchestrator) fails open with no hard env gate, so a missing required var surfaces as request-time failures rather than a refused boot.
risks.mitigation: Preflight + validate-deployment + prechecklist catch missing required vars BEFORE deploy; documented in the schema §6. Deliberately not adding a throw-on-boot gate in this pass (out of scope; would risk taking a running owner instance down on a transient read).

overall: All owner-self-use deploy risks have concrete, mostly test-enforced mitigations. One medium residual (no hard boot-time env gate) is documented and deferred, not hidden.
